findings.title: PersistentVolume is Released and does not bind again
findings.cause: PersistentVolumeClaim data stays Pending: PersistentVolume kd-pv-released fits it, but is Released: it still carries the reference to claim kd-pv-released/old-data, which was deleted, and a Released volume is bound to no other claim until that reference is cleared (reclaim policy Retain keeps the volume and its data for that decision); the 3 other volumes without a class do not fit either

evidence.command: kubectl get pvc data -n kd-pv-released -o jsonpath='{.status.phase}'

evidence.what: claim asks for 1Gi; ReadWriteOnce; storageClassName "", which turns dynamic provisioning off
PersistentVolume kd-pv-released is Released: it still carries the reference to its deleted claim kd-pv-released/old-data

findings.fix: If the data on kd-pv-released may go to the new claim, or does not matter, clear the reference so that the volume is Available again: kubectl patch pv kd-pv-released --type=json -p '[{"op":"remove","path":"/spec/claimRef"}]'. Otherwise create a new PersistentVolume for the claim.
